stem_text: An automobile of mass 'm' accelerates starting from origin and initially at rest, while the engine supplies constant power P. The position is given as a function of time by :

candidate_solve.derivation: Power definition: P = F * v = (m * dv/dt) * v. Separating variables: P dt = m v dv. Integrating from rest (v=0 at t=0): P t = 1/2 m v^2 => v(t) = sqrt(2Pt/m) = (2P/m)^(1/2) * t^(1/2). Since v = dx/dt and starting from origin (x=0 at t=0): x(t) = integral_0^t (2P/m)^(1/2) * tau^(1/2) dtau = (2P/m)^(1/2) * (2/3) * t^(3/2) = sqrt( (4/9) * (2P/m) ) * t^(3/2) = (8P / (9m))^(1/2) * t^(3/2). This corresponds exactly to Option D.
candidate_solve.limiting_cases: If P=0, x=0. If m -> infinity, x -> 0. As t -> 0, x -> 0. Dimensional analysis: [P/m] = (kg m^2 s^-3) / kg = m^2 s^-3. [(P/m)^(1/2) * t^(3/2)] = (m s^(-3/2)) * s^(3/2) = m (meters). Options A, C, D have correct dimensions; option B has incorrect time exponent 2/3. Constant power requires exponent 3/2 with coefficient sqrt(8/9).
